name: Wheels

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
  release:
    types:
      - published

permissions:
  contents: read


jobs:
  build_bdist:
    name: "Build ${{ matrix.os }} (${{ matrix.cibw_platform }}-${{ matrix.arch }}) wheels"
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60  # should be long enough even on tags, but let's prevent hangs
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            arch: x86_64
            cibw_platform: linux
          - name: Pyodide
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            arch: auto
            cibw_platform: pyodide
          - name: Linux-arm
            os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            arch: aarch64
            cibw_platform: linux
          - name: Windows
            os: windows-2022
            arch: AMD64
            cibw_platform: windows
          - name: macOS-arm
            os: macos-15
            arch: arm64
            cibw_platform: macos
          - name: macOS-intel
            os: macos-15-intel
            arch: x86_64
            cibw_platform: macos

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: "Building ${{ matrix.os }} (${{ matrix.arch }}) wheels"
      uses: pypa/cibuildwheel@f9b966cfadf4109556cadc5bb39ddb72d0ce664e  # v4.3.5
      env:
        CIBW_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.cibw_platform }}
        CIBW_SKIP: "*-musllinux*"
        CIBW_BUILD: "cp311-* cp314-*"
        CIBW_ARCHS: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        CIBW_BUILD_FRONTEND: build
        CIBW_MANYLINUX_X86_64_IMAGE: manylinux_2_28
        CIBW_TEST_REQUIRES: abi3audit pytest pandas>=2
        CIBW_TEST_COMMAND: >
          python -c "import gsw; print(f'gsw v{gsw.__version__}')" &&
          python -m pytest --pyargs gsw
        CIBW_TEST_COMMAND_LINUX:
          abi3audit ${{ github.workspace }}/wheelhouse/*.whl --summary --assume-minimum-abi3 3.11 --verbose --strict

    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
      with:
        name: pypi-artifacts-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/wheelhouse/*.whl
    permissions:
      actions: write

  build_sdist:
    name: Build source distribution
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build sdist
        run: >
          pip install build twine check-manifest
          && python -m build --sdist . --outdir dist
          && twine check dist/*
          && check-manifest --verbose

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: pypi-artifacts
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/dist/*.tar.gz
    permissions:
      actions: write

  show-artifacts:
    needs: [build_bdist, build_sdist]
    name: "Show artifacts"
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333  # v8.0.2
      with:
        pattern: pypi-artifacts*
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/dist
        merge-multiple: true

    - shell: bash
      run: |
        ls -l ${{ github.workspace }}/dist
    permissions:
      actions: none

  publish-artifacts-pypi:
    needs: [build_bdist, build_sdist]
    name: "Publish to PyPI"
    run

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

      - 'NOTICE'
      - 'README*'
      - 'site.yaml'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'editorconfig'
      - '.gitattributes'
      - '.gitignore'
      - 'CONTRIBUTING*'
      - 'CODEOWNERS'
      - 'KEYS'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'NOTICE'
      - 'README*'
      - 'site.yaml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [17, 21]
    name: build with jdk ${{matrix.java}}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        name: checkout
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merge_commit_sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        name: set up jdk ${{matrix.java}}
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: ${{matrix.java}}

      - name: Cache Maven packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: build with maven
        run: |
            mvn -q -N io.takari:
